lxc_c559838c791ec4bf.text: What do kids in the USA eat for breakfast?

lxc_8d87a283c02021a9.text: How do they go to school?

lxc_daf3d7e2c0582a5b.text: Many kids ride a big yellow bus.

lxc_c8b80af7a5186c37.text: At school, they read, write, play and eat lunch with friends.

lxc_87b291940b5628c2.text: After school, they play and do homework.

lxc_37ae6cdf7c8e10e9.text: Let's read about breakfast, school, games and dinner.

lxc_4d9df97b805ea058.text: It is seven o'clock in the morning.

lxc_386db620698b0aa2.text: They put the cereal in a bowl and add milk.

lxc_18f4d68b123e4337.text: After breakfast, children get their school bag.

lxc_97a596a94d8e35bf.text: They put in books, pencils and a water bottle.

lxc_e6e63d40ce16c7ef.text: Children get on the bus and sit with friends.

lxc_3eb01e5837001ea5.text: Children get off and say hello to their teacher.

lxc_3744467859de8970.text: They say hello to their friends.

lxc_9101c83af405a982.text: They put their bags away and sit at their desks.

lxc_42604b907853497a.text: The teacher reads a story to the class.

lxc_8953f8b7940c7417.text: The teacher writes on the board.

lxc_0d6444f90baee4f7.text: Children put a hand up to ask a question.

lxc_9088364310102bb4.text: After class, it is time to play.

lxc_94d6f46b5e9c7374.text: Then it is time for lunch.

lxc_b3d9bba7e987fcbe.text: It has long tables and many chairs.

lxc_42ffe285da19e17d.text: Children sit and eat with friends.

lxc_b04ca3d8410b9179.text: A lunch box can have a sandwich, an apple or cheese.

lxc_9d99d199b2928380.text: School lunch can be pizza, chicken, rice, salad or fruit.

lxc_090874188be9bf5b.text: Children have more to learn and do.

lxc_2b5b3b9989db6a92.text: There is time for art, music, games and science.

lxc_1a00d7fd05ac06d3.text: They cut paper and make things.

lxc_41b1e7579b9a1c97.text: Children go to a big room for games.

lxc_52c675262aa4ac6b.text: They look at pictures and ask questions.

lxc_8b102777577cf7d0.text: At the end of the day, children clean the classroom.

lxc_da3e27ef3a720d13.text: The school day ends in the afternoon.

lxc_3e678f9a45136c17.text: A snack is a little food between meals.

lxc_ac1d59937fd862b9.text: It can be an apple, cheese or a cookie.

lxc_762d3da072496b30.text: Homework is school work at home.

lxc_ae01e32c018bef3b.text: A yard is the grass next to a house.

lxc_7ff4789bd91be616.text: In the evening, the family eats dinner.

lxc_74f860db61e64cc3.text: Dinner can be chicken, rice or soup with vegetables.

lxc_c1f2ffb6bacd8a21.text: They put things on the table for dinner.

lxc_311bac74be9015ad.text: After dinner, they help clean the table.

lxc_df1b7a3b189462c1.text: They take a bath or a shower.

lxc_a0ea3e8c45f40006.text: They put on clean clothes for bed.

lxc_5f9425d43b2ab7b8.text: Then they brush their teeth again.

lxc_c556d758d2abe102.text: On the weekend, there is no school.

lxc_f273578774259336.text: Children can sleep a little longer.

lxc_90281eb316fb1cb4.text: They play, see family and go to sports games.

lxc_f4503c872096cfc7.text: You visit a school in the USA for one day.

lxc_b818390899b5f501.text: You walk into the big, loud cafeteria with your lunch box.

lxc_03ab57f4c9b4831f.text: A girl named Mia sits at a long table.

lxc_465f3bddff442208.text: There is a free chair next to her.

lxc_c048aaa7a8dbcfce.text: Your goal is to sit with Mia, talk about lunch and after school, and say goodbye at the end of lunch.

lxc_936fcd974bb3baae.text: Tell a partner about your day.

lxc_49a5a45c1e1888e4.text: Use short sentences, from morning to night.

lxc_89dfa324b9fe8b28.text: Say what time you wake up and what you eat for breakfast.

lxc_b2221860aa647dcb.text: Say how you go to school.

lxc_e5c5c3d0a7069128.text: Name your classes in the morning and the afternoon.

lxc_dd3a131c15f24817.text: Say what you eat for lunch and where you eat it.

lxc_b25a58c3ffa9bb03.text: Say what you do after school and before bed.

lxc_d27315e03608368a.text: Then ask your partner the same questions.

lxc_68b36f52cfdf9755.text: Find two things that are the same in your days.

lxc_92f9439d01c3a27a.text: Find one thing that is different from a day in the USA.
